verified_facts.text: Beach Village at The Del is a private beachfront enclave of cottages and villas on the sands of Coronado Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: A private, beachfront enclave dotted with picture-perfect cottages and villas, Beach Village at The Del® is an idyllic sanctuary on the sparkling sands of Coronado Beach.

verified_facts.text: Beach Village is a private enclave within the Hotel del Coronado.
verified_facts.excerpt: A private enclave within the legendary Hotel del Coronado

verified_facts.text: Beach Village is a gated community of beachfront cottages and villas.
verified_facts.excerpt: A gated community of picture-perfect beachfront cottages and villas

verified_facts.text: A stay at Beach Village includes a personal concierge.
verified_facts.excerpt: your stay at Beach Village includes a personal concierge to take care of every detail

verified_facts.text: Beach Village offers a private welcome experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beach Village offers dedicated personal concierge service throughout your stay, a private welcome experience, gated access, priority reservations across the resort

verified_facts.text: Beach Village guests get priority reservations across the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beach Village offers dedicated personal concierge service throughout your stay, a private welcome experience, gated access, priority reservations across the resort

verified_facts.text: Beach Village has the Oval Pool plus secluded plunge pools and jacuzzis throughout its grounds.
verified_facts.excerpt: Find your poolside haven at the Beach Village Oval Pool or one of the secluded plunge pools and jacuzzis throughout the lush grounds.

verified_facts.text: The Oval Pool has private cabanas and cabanettes, with the Breezes poolside bistro delivering coastal fare to your chair.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Oval Pool offers luxe chaise lounges, plush private cabanas, and intimate cabanettes with Breezes poolside bistro for coastal fare delivered to your chair.

verified_facts.text: Complimentary Del Beach sand chairs and umbrellas are included with a Beach Village stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax on the sand in your complimentary Del Beach sand chairs and umbrellas included with your Beach Village stay.

verified_facts.text: Guests can reserve Del Beach daybeds and half-moon cabanettes.
verified_facts.excerpt: For a more luxurious experience, reserve plush Del Beach daybeds and half-moon cabanettes.

verified_facts.text: Beach Village guests may request personal shopping, party planning and VIP tours at local attractions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests may also request personal shopping, party planning, VIP tours at local attractions and more.

verified_facts.text: Beach Village guests enjoy priority seating at the resort's dining outlets.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beach Village guests enjoy priority seating at our dining outlets.

verified_facts.text: The Beachfront Fireside Cottage is a ground-floor cottage with a beachfront terrace with fire pit, full kitchen, living room with fireplace and a marble bathroom.
verified_facts.excerpt: Newly renovated ground floor cottage with large beachfront terrace with fire pit, full kitchen, living room with fireplace and sofa bed, master bedroom, and marble bathroom.

verified_facts.text: The Oceanfront Horizon Cottage is a top-floor cottage with an oceanfront balcony and day tub, two fireplaces and a private study.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unique, newly renovated top floor cottage with expansive oceanfront balcony and day tub, full kitchen, living room with sofa bed, master bedroom, two fireplaces, 1.5 baths, and a private study with sofa bed.

verified_facts.text: The Oceanview Villa Loft is a two-story villa with oceanview balconies, a full kitchen and an outdoor day tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beautifully renovated, two-story Villa with 2 bedrooms, 2 oceanview balconies, full kitchen, living room with sofa bed, 2 baths, fireplace, and an outdoor day tub.

verified_facts.text: The three-bedroom Beachfront Fireside Cottage has a beachfront terrace with three fire pits and a full kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beautifully renovated ground-floor Cottage with 3 bedrooms, expansive beachfront terrace with 3 fire pits, full kitchen, living room, 3 separate bedrooms, 3 baths, 3 sofa beds, and 3 fireplaces.

verified_facts.text: Beach Village experiences include gathering around a private beach bonfire.
verified_facts.excerpt: from quiet moments watching a perfect sunset, savoring the day's fresh catch from an oceanfront restaurant, or gathering around a private beach bonfire.

verified_facts.text: Beach Village is part of LXR Hotels & Resorts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Part of LXR Hotels & Resorts, an exclusive group of select hotels found in the most intriguing corners of the world.

verified_facts.text: Beach Village has mobility and hearing accessible rooms, including one with a roll-in shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mobility & Hearing Accessible with Roll-In Shower

verified_facts.text: The cottages and villas are whole-ownership, limited-term occupancy resort residential condominiums.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Cottages and Villas advertised are whole-ownership, limited-term occupancy resort residential condominiums.
